releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder support Custom weekday recurrence. All previous repeat options for each section, saved entries, snooze timing and limits, ringtone, notifications and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 357: Corrected the mobile full-screen position of Delete Ki Huwi Note so the close control, trash button and deleted-note list remain visible. Restore, permanent delete, 30-day expiry and saved note data are preserved.
